title: R with CBAM attention and GeM pooling
summary: R + CBAM + GeM: below plain R
hypothesis: Attention (CBAM) and learnable pooling (GeM) may help plant-part localisation.
findings: CBAM+GeM is worse than plain R alone (0.638 vs 0.672) but adds diversity for an ensemble (EXP-010).
limitations: TTA setting for this run is not recorded in its log.
